info.brief: Functions and constants for interacting with permissions related APIs
info.description: Functions and constants for interacting with permissions related APIs

elements.name: permissions.check
elements.description: Determine whether you have been granted a particular permission.

parameters.name: permission
parameters.doc: A constant that represent permission, for example `android.permission.ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE`

returnvalues.name: result
returnvalues.doc:
A result can be one of the predefined constants below
- `permissions.PERMISSION_GRANTED`
- `permissions.PERMISSION_DENIED`
- `permissions.PERMISSION_SHOW_RATIONALE`

elements.name: permissions.request
elements.description: Requests permissions to be granted to this application.

parameters.name: request_tbl
parameters.doc: An array with constants that represent permissions.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.doc: A callback taking the following parameters

elements.name: permissions.PERMISSION_GRANTED
elements.brief: The permission has been granted to the given package.
elements.description: The permission has been granted to the given package.

elements.name: permissions.PERMISSION_DENIED
elements.brief: The permission has not been granted to the given package.
elements.description: The permission has not been granted to the given package.
